description: Finds the lowest, highest and average of up to four voltages, with a gate on each channel showing that it holds the lowest or the highest

params.text: Sets a voltage from -5V to +5V, used as the D channel while the ON button is lit and nothing is patched into the D input
Lit, channel D is counted in the comparison using the BIAS voltage even with nothing patched into the D input
Lit, the gate outputs swing between -5V and +5V instead of 0V and 10V

inputs.text: One of the four voltages compared; only patched inputs are counted

outputs.text: High while its channel holds the highest of the input voltages; high is 10V and low 0V, or +5V and -5V with BIPOLAR lit
High while its channel holds the lowest of the input voltages; high is 10V and low 0V, or +5V and -5V with BIPOLAR lit
The lowest of the voltages present at the inputs
The highest of the voltages present at the inputs
The average of the voltages present at the inputs

notes: this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel
